name.fr-FR: Correspondance de saint Vincent de Paul, tome IV
name.en-US: Correspondence of St. Vincent de Paul, vol. IV
name.pt-BR: Correspondência de São Vicente de Paulo, tomo IV

description.fr-FR: Les lettres 1206 à 1645 de la Correspondance de saint Vincent, tome IV de l’édition de Pierre Coste (1650-1653), une lettre par chapitre, groupées par année, avec les lettres adressées à Vincent que Coste y a intercalées, ses notices de sources et ses notes.
description.en-US: Letters 1206 to 1645 of St. Vincent’s Correspondence, vol. IV of Pierre Coste’s edition (1650-1653), one letter per chapter and grouped by year, with the letters addressed to Vincent that Coste interleaves, his source notices and notes.
description.pt-BR: As cartas 1206 a 1645 da Correspondência de São Vicente, tomo IV da edição de Pierre Coste (1650-1653).

sources.edition: Saint Vincent de Paul, Correspondance, entretiens, documents, éd. Pierre Coste C.M., Paris: Gabalda, 1920-1925, tome IV; digital edition by P. Claude Lautissier C.M. and the Daughters of Charity (1992), on JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: All letters of the tome, one per chapter, including the letters to Vincent that Coste prints among them, with Coste’s source notices and footnotes kept as notes. Coste’s introduction is not included; letters whose heading the transcription lost stay inside the preceding chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Vincent died in 1660; Coste’s edition appeared in 1920-25 and Coste died in 1935. The digital transcription is of the same text, with Coste’s notes.
